products.name: Smartcat
products.note: Translation management AI; CAT tool; vendor marketplace; translation memory governance

profile_text.body:
Smartcat describes itself as an all-in-one AI translation and localization platform, offering AI translation, AI localization, AI content generation, and combined AI-human workflows. The platform is designed for organizations that need to produce global content at scale, and it includes a translation management system, an advanced computer-assisted translation tool, and payment automation that allows clients to hire and pay multiple translators under a single monthly invoice. The site states that Smartcat's AI translation technology matches content to specific translation engines, learns from user edits over time, and supports popular translation memory formats so that existing translation databases can be transferred in and used to improve output quality.

A central feature of the platform is the Smartcat Marketplace, which the company says contains more than 500,000 linguists available for hire, with AI-driven sourcing to help automate supplier selection and management. Smartcat operates an unlimited seat model, allowing organizations to invite any number of colleagues to collaborate on translation projects. The platform targets a range of roles including localization managers, marketers, product managers, and learning and development managers, and it serves industries such as life sciences, retail and consumer goods, manufacturing, and automotive.

The site's held facts record Smartcat as a single tracked product in the search, research, translation, and other category, described as a translation management AI combining a CAT tool, a vendor marketplace, and translation memory governance. No litigation, patent filings, or SEC records are present in the available data.
